text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Four inmates at Zimbabwe's Chikurubi Maximum Prison attempted to escape from jail on Monday morning after shooting dead a prison guard. One of the prisoners was later also shot dead, two were apprehended but one is still at large.
- Two Zimbabwean families have invested almost $60 million in a new fertiliser blending plant, which when fully operational will initially create 20 jobs.
